meta.title: About us
meta.description: Market Balance Co., Ltd. is a team of specialists with field experience in Korea and abroad who take overseas exhibitions, export marketing and buyer sourcing from plan to result.

intro.title: About us
intro.lead: Who Market Balance is, and how we work with you.

vision.title: Overview
paragraphs: Market Balance Co., Ltd. is a team of specialists with hands-on experience in Korea and abroad. We run trade fair participation, market research, export meetings, buyer sourcing and matching, conferences, investor briefings, roadshows and overseas marketing consulting.
One team stays with your project from planning and budgeting to delivery and the final report.
vision.photoAlt: Visitors walking through an overseas exhibition hall

principles.title: We work to results
principles.desc: An event is not the finish line. We carry the work from objectives and strategy through operations, performance review and follow-up business.

principles.title: Every company gets its own strategy
principles.desc: We design each plan around the company and its industry, from market diagnosis to the execution roadmap.

principles.title: Budgets and progress stay open
principles.desc: You see every stage with us: planning, budget, delivery and reporting.

strengths.title: Key strengths
strengths.intro: Five things worth checking before you hand over an overseas project.

items.title: A CEO with 20+ years in the field
items.desc: Know-how from export marketing, exhibitions and conventions that solves problems quickly.

items.title: Dedicated teams with 10+ years' experience
items.desc: Each project gets its own team of specialists with at least ten years of on-site MICE work.

items.title: Partners in some 20 countries
items.desc: With partners across the Americas, Europe, China, Vietnam and more, we plan for each market on its own terms.

items.title: 20+ international events a year
items.desc: We plan and run large international events every year, including overseas buyer meetings, export fairs and trade missions.

items.title: Buyer sourcing by industry
items.desc: We target leading buyers in fields such as ICT, bio and renewable energy, and set up meetings with a real chance of a deal.

network.title: Overseas network
